question: Find Melanoma trials with minimum follow‑up and show months by arm.

gemini.answer: This query selects melanoma trials and displays follow-up duration, ordering by overall follow-up duration in descending order to show trials with the longest follow-up first, along with trial identifiers, author, year, and PubMed ID.
gemini.raw:
```json
{
  "sql": "SELECT \"nct\", \"author\", \"year\", \"pubmed_id\",\n       \"follow_up_duration_overall_months\", \n       \"follow_up_duration_rx_months\",\n       \"follow_up_duration_control_months\"\nFROM public.\"clinical_trials\"\nWHERE \"cancer_type\" ILIKE '%Melanoma%'\nORDER BY \"follow_up_duration_overall_months\" DESC NULLS LAST",
  "answer": "This query selects melanoma trials and displays follow-up duration, ordering by overall follow-up duration in descending order to show trials with the longest follow-up first, along with trial identifiers, author, year, and PubMed ID.",
  "assumptions": ""
}
```
